commands.command:
cat > /root/ansible-appworker/playbook.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Create appworker account with resource limits
  hosts: targets
  become: true
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Check whether appworker user exists
      ansible.builtin.raw: id -u appworker >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo PRESENT || echo ABSENT
      register: user_check
      changed_when: false

    - name: Create appworker user
      ansible.builtin.raw: useradd -m -s /bin/bash appworker
      when: "'ABSENT' in user_check.stdout"
      register: user_create
      changed_when: "user_create.rc == 0"

    - name: Read current appworker limits file
      ansible.builtin.raw: cat /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf 2>/dev/null || true
      register: limits_check
      changed_when: false

    - name: Write appworker nofile/nproc limits
      ansible.builtin.raw: >-
        printf '%s\n' 'appworker soft nofile 8192' 'appworker hard nofile 8192' 'appworker soft nproc 256' 'appworker hard nproc 256' > /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf
      when: >
        'appworker soft nofile 8192' not in limits_check.stdout or
        'appworker hard nofile 8192' not in limits_check.stdout or
        'appworker soft nproc 256' not in limits_check.stdout or
        'appworker hard nproc 256' not in limits_check.stdout
      register: limits_write
      changed_when: "limits_write.rc == 0"
EOF
